description: Light rail with charging dwell REMOVED. Isolates the wire-free decision (secondary question S-a): what the late 35m urban amenity package cost in run time. Zero is outside the 10-35 s sweep BY DESIGN - the sweep is the range of plausible values for a system that charges, and this scenario is the counterfactual in which it does not.

justification.A.lightrail.dwell_charging_s: S2a is DEFINED as the no-charging-dwell counterfactual (proposal 4.3). Setting it to zero is the scenario, not a parameter choice, and the difference S2 minus S2a is the reported quantity for S-a.
